sloka: तिर्यग्योनिगतानां च शतानि सरयूजलम् ।सम्प्राप्य त्रिदिवं जग्मुः प्रभासुरवपूंषि च ।दिव्या दिव्येन वपुषा देवा दीप्ता इवाभवन् ।। ७.११०.२५ ॥
transliteration: tiryagyonigatānāṁ ca śatāni sarayūjalam ।samprāpya tridivaṁ jagmuḥ prabhāsuravapūṁṣi ca ।divyā divyena vapuṣā devā dīptā ivābhavan ।। 7.110.25 ॥

translations.english: And hundreds of animals, having attained the water of Sarayu, went to heaven with radiant bodies, becoming like shining gods with divine forms.
